_comment: One hook per Coherent view: each view is its own JS context and needs hidpi.js loaded separately. A hook is a cooked component the view mounts AFTER Community packages are mounted (the notifications view is created at sim startup, so components it builds then come from the stock files): it gets a hidden that loads hidpi.js once per view. Panel views set their own viewportScreenHeight and are left alone. Avoid components other mods override (paul-fs24-lite: BlurPage, Panel_Header, Gauge_Circular; paul-fs24-ui: MenuBarPage; //42 Flow: Startpage, HUD_*, Shortcutblock).

injections.screen: notifications: input bar keys (Esc / Select), popups
